text: The QR unit fixture still calls its account noOutgoingServerAccount, although its comment and assertion say it uses the default SMTP server. Proposed manual naming rule for this test family: use a name such as defaultOutgoingServerAccount for that fixture. Keep an absent-server fixture distinct from an empty-key fallback fixture; the current source establishes the behavior, not an approved project-wide naming rule. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Name a default-server test for the fallback it exercises
